tool_args.rationale: The slow-horizon probe establishes the predicted reversal through the target horizon. Fit all four parameters numerically and test the resulting stationary dual-exponential law on fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The measured response changes from positive at short horizons to negative at long horizons.
All observed sink gradients are zero, and the archive's simpler dual-horizon law directly matches the observed reversal.
The acquired long-horizon points and five pilot rows provide observations across both response timescales; further measurement is deferred pending confirmation.
